rationale.consistency: License headers, module registration, interface guards and directive ordering follow siblings; but handler uses time.Duration fields plus hand-written Marshal/UnmarshalJSON instead of the codebase's caddy.Duration convention.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles hard-deadline capping, credit overflow, zero-length writes, ErrNotSupported fallback and rate-without-timeout defaulting; server-level idle timeouts never default to 1 minute, and the write deadline is left set on keep-alive connections after the request.
rationale.scope: Core requirement met, but adds unrequested positional args, read_min_rate/write_min_rate/max_write_chunk subdirectives, a write_max_chunk JSON alias, min-rate args on server Caddyfile options and a /s-suffix rate parser.
rationale.readability: Clear split into IdleDeadline/Reader/Writer with doc comments; Calculate silently mutates Start, and repeated nil checks on the embedded wrapper add noise.
rationale.robustness: Pre-checks expired deadlines, tolerates controller errors, no panics on bad config; nil-wrapper path in Write would loop forever, and stale write deadlines are not cleared post-request.
rationale.maintainability: Shared wrapper types are reusable, but the timeout/rate defaulting logic is duplicated across server, handler Provision and ServeHTTP, and the custom JSON alias marshalling is brittle to field additions.
